title: Source-grounded extraction & machine retrieval
motto: EXTRACT THE SOURCE. PROVE THE RECORD. THEN LET AI DERIVE.

language_stack.primary: Python (modular per-format adapters, typed schemas, validation and orchestration)
language_stack.structured: JSON Schema + JSONL evidence; SQL + SQLite FTS5/private relational lookup; Parquet for approved large numeric tables
language_stack.view: JavaScript/HTML on public GitHub Pages for protocol explanation only
language_stack.domain: GDAL/GeoPackage and IFCOpenShell/IFC for relevant GIS/BIM; native proprietary app APIs for ETABS, SAP2000, Revit and SKP

core_principle: Keep immutable originals under their owning provider permissions; extract typed evidence with exact native locators, stable IDs, hash/revision, units and method; validate before retrieval or derivation. Do not store private extracted records on public GitHub Pages.

pipeline.title: Resolve authority & permissions
pipeline.description: Resolve provider, owning module, file ID/revision, permitted use, ACL and file signature. Respect revocation.

pipeline.title: Snapshot original without modification
pipeline.description: Capture cryptographic hash, byte size, MIME, version, parser compatibility and related sidecars/xrefs. Preserve source binary.

pipeline.title: Extract in native semantic order
pipeline.description: Use authenticated API/native exporter or loss-aware parser. Capture tables, text, geometry, formulas, units, relationships and warnings; OCR only if necessary.

pipeline.title: Normalize typed evidence
pipeline.description: Write structured JSONL with source locators; transform to Parquet, GeoPackage, IFC or SQLite views as appropriate, never hide conversion losses.

pipeline.title: Run independent quality gates
pipeline.description: Check schema and object counts, nulls, sheets, geometry, units, CRS, IDs, source parity, cross-reference integrity and discrepancies.

pipeline.title: Index for authorized retrieval
pipeline.description: Use SQLite FTS5/full-text and filters, spatial indexes for geometry and optional embeddings for ranking. Query access-controlled records only.

pipeline.title: Derive with evidence + explicit limits
pipeline.description: Return cited source locators, transformations, code/build version, validation outcome and uncertainty; mark missing evidence as HOLD/NEEDS_INPUT.

formats.label: PDF · born-digital or scanned
formats.method: PyMuPDF / pypdf first; region/page-aware extraction. Render/OCR scanned portions only with evidence labelling.
formats.output: JSONL text blocks and tables; optional searchable text
formats.locator: Page number, block or bounding box, exact quote, extraction method
formats.hold: Scanned text and drawings require OCR/visual confirmation; never infer missing values.

formats.label: Word & Google Docs
formats.method: python-docx or OOXML reader; Google Docs API for authenticated document structure and revisions.
formats.output: JSONL paragraphs/tables; Markdown as human-readable derivative
formats.hold: Preserve comments, revisions and embedded objects separately; exports can omit features.

formats.label: Excel workbooks
formats.method: openpyxl for OOXML worksheets and formulas; LibreOffice or Excel calculation only when authorized.
formats.output: JSONL cells/formulas; Parquet normalized rows; private SQLite indexes
formats.locator: Workbook sheet name, exact A1 cell/range, formula, cached value, number format
formats.hold: Cached formula result can be missing or stale; do not evaluate unknown macros or equate formula with result.

formats.label: Google Sheets
formats.method: Authenticated Sheets API values.get/batchGet and metadata/protected-range endpoints.
formats.output: JSONL cells/tables; Parquet for approved analytic copies
formats.locator: Spreadsheet ID (private), tab ID, A1 range, version/modified time
formats.hold: Values API alone may omit formulas, formatting, formulas' recalculation state and protections.

formats.label: Delimited data
formats.method: Python csv / pandas or pyarrow CSV with explicit delimiter, encoding, schema and locale.
formats.output: Parquet for analytics; JSONL rows; SQLite for private joins
formats.locator: Source hash, row number, column, header mapping
formats.hold: A CSV loses original formulas, formats, relations and permissions; preserve types and nulls.

formats.label: AutoCAD DXF
formats.method: ezdxf for layers, blocks, inserts, entities, layouts and handles.
formats.output: JSONL CAD entities; geometry table; optional approved IFC/SVG viewer
formats.locator: Entity handle, layer, layout, block path, coordinate transform, native units
formats.hold: Units, UCS, xrefs, paperspace and blocks need explicit resolution; drawing is not certified design.

formats.label: AutoCAD DWG
formats.method: Approved CAD/native reader or ODA tooling; export reviewed DXF with source-version trace.
formats.output: DXF plus JSONL entity extraction; original DWG retained
formats.locator: Native entity identifier/handle, layer, layout, source hash
formats.hold: Never rename binary DWG to DXF; different versions and external references can affect completeness.

formats.label: Unrecognized DWC extension
formats.method: First inspect true filename, signature, MIME and originating application; request native specification.
formats.locator: Source name and hash; identifying app/version required
formats.hold: Do not silently reinterpret DWC as DWG or fabricate an extraction pathway.

formats.label: SketchUp models
formats.method: SketchUp C SDK or authorized native export, with group/component transforms.
formats.output: Element records and material metadata; GLB for read-only visualization
formats.locator: Component persistent ID/path, layer/tag, geometry transform, units
formats.hold: Meshes/GLB previews are not equivalent to construction semantics; preserve instances and units.

formats.label: IFC / Revit BIM
formats.method: IfcOpenShell for IFC; native Revit API or explicitly authorized IFC export for RVT.
formats.output: IFC schema-guided entity JSONL, Parquet quantities, optional GLB viewer
formats.locator: IFC GlobalId, property set, placement, model revision, units
formats.hold: RVT is not a generic IFC file; geometry-only conversion can lose semantics, parameters and relations.

formats.label: Shapefile bundles
formats.method: GDAL/OGR or GeoPandas; validate all sidecar files together.
formats.output: GeoPackage or GeoParquet with attributes and CRS
formats.locator: Feature ID, layer, spatial reference/WKT, geometry, attribute origin
formats.hold: Do not treat only .shp as complete; missing DBF/SHX/CRS or encoding can corrupt meaning.

formats.label: ArcGIS File Geodatabase / GeoPackage
formats.method: GDAL OpenFileGDB / OGR or ArcPy for authenticated native workflows.
formats.output: GeoPackage; GeoParquet for analysis; relational feature records
formats.locator: Dataset/layer/table name, feature ID, coordinate system, source revision
formats.hold: Maintain attachments, domains, subtype rules and geometry fidelity; validate unsupported classes.

formats.label: ArcGIS projects and services
formats.method: ArcPy/ArcGIS Pro for native project references; ArcGIS REST Feature Service APIs for layers.
formats.output: Layer references and service snapshots with provenance; GeoPackage only when export permitted
formats.locator: Project/layer identifier, portal item or service revision, CRS, service query
formats.hold: A project file references data; do not assume it contains the whole geodatabase. Respect service permissions.

formats.label: GeoTIFF and GIS rasters
formats.method: rasterio/GDAL inspect geotransform, raster bands, nodata and CRS.
formats.output: COG/GeoTIFF retained; raster statistics JSONL; tiles for approved preview
formats.locator: Band, pixel/window, CRS, resolution, nodata, source hash
formats.hold: Reprojection/resampling changes pixel values; record transformation and native units.

formats.label: ETABS models
formats.method: CSI ETABS native application/API for .edb; official .e2k text export and approved tables.
formats.output: JSONL nodes, elements, loads and analysis tables; Parquet table exports
formats.locator: Object/story, case/combo, direction, software version, model revision, units
formats.hold: Native model opening/export may require licensed Windows environment; parser PASS is not analysis or engineering approval.

formats.label: SAP2000 models
formats.method: CSI SAP2000 application/API and reviewed .s2k text/tables; preserve original .sdb.
formats.output: JSONL frame/joint/load/case records; Parquet result tables
formats.locator: Native object ID, load case, combination, analysis step, units/version
formats.hold: Case results depend on executed solver, model state and settings; never invent missing tables.

formats.label: Images, archives and text sources
formats.method: Pillow/OpenCV image metadata; manifest ZIP members securely; decode JSON/MD directly with schema.
formats.output: JSONL metadata/annotations; image derivatives only with consent; extracted text if present
formats.locator: EXIF/frame/region, archive member path, hash and known transform
formats.hold: No visual fact claim without inspection; ZIP may contain nested private items; never publish recursively.

outputs.role: Evidence-level canonical records and typed, replayable provenance
Efficient searchable retrieval, joins, exact filters and audit-friendly local snapshots
High-volume typed tables, numerical analysis and column scans
GIS geometry, attributes and coordinate reference metadata
BIM entity identities and relationships; GLB for view-only geometry projection
Human review and exports only, not replacement for complete source semantics

safeguards: Exact matches and native element locators outrank semantic guesses; vectors/embeddings rank candidates but never become proof.
A parser success does not prove engineering accuracy or drawings issued for construction.
Missing files, units, CRS, source pages, xrefs, formulas, solver runs and permissions cause explicit gaps/HOLD, not fabricated values.
Content must be current with the authorized source revision; stale caches are labelled, invalidated or blocked.
Conversions are derivative; keep lossy/unsupported fields and software versions documented.
Only synthetic format guidance is published here; there is no upload, connector sync, private extraction corpus or user document ingestion in A7.
